content:
Why are you acting like this? Seriously, look at yourself. You’re spiraling over absolutely nothing, and it’s honestly exhausting.

I don’t know why you’re so obsessed with "what happened." Nothing happened. Are you seriously going to bring this up again? We’ve been over this. You’re letting your imagination run wild because you’re insecure, and I’m tired of paying the price for your trust issues.

Maybe if you weren't so paranoid and controlling, you’d actually see how much I do for this relationship. But no, you’d rather pick fights and manufacture drama out of thin air. It’s almost like you *want* to be miserable, like you’re trying to ruin things between us because you don’t think you deserve me.

I saw him text me back? *Seriously?* It was a work thing, and if you hadn’t violated my privacy by going through my phone like a stalker, you wouldn't be in this position to begin with. That’s on you, not me.

Stop crying. You’re being hysterical. I never said I was with him, you just *decided* that, and now you’re punishing me for a reality that only exists in your head. Do you even hear how crazy you sound right now? If you want to keep acting like this, fine, but don't come crying to me when you push me away for good. I’m done—I’m just done talking about this. Get over yourself.
